name: Cursor
tagline: An AI coding editor for understanding projects and making coordinated code changes.
description: Cursor combines a code editor with an AI agent that searches projects, edits files, and runs commands. Describe a change in natural language, inspect the work, and refine it in the same environment.

features.label: Project-aware changes
features.text: Agent reads and edits the files needed to carry a request across a project.

features.label: Search and command tools
features.text: Find code and web information, then run terminal commands as part of a task.

features.label: Recoverable editing sessions
features.text: Checkpoints capture modified files so you can preview or restore an earlier state.

useCases.label: Explore unfamiliar code
useCases.text: Locate relevant files and ask how a feature is implemented before planning changes.

useCases.label: Implement and refine a change
useCases.text: Describe a feature or refactor, then inspect edits and command output to guide revisions.

limitations: Checkpoints are local to Agent sessions and do not replace Git history or other permanent version control.
Agent access and model usage depend on the plan; additional model usage can carry separate charges.
guide.pricingNote: A free plan offers limited AI usage. Paid individual and organization plans expand access; check official allowances and any separate model usage charges.

alternatives.reason: Compare for AI assistance inside supported editors and GitHub workflows.
Compare for an agent centered on coding tasks in a development environment.
Explore another editor with integrated AI development features.

faqs.question: Can Cursor edit more than one project file?
faqs.answer: Yes. Agent can modify files across a project during a coding task.

faqs.question: Can I undo changes made by Cursor Agent?
faqs.answer: Checkpoints let you restore captured file states. Use Git for permanent version control.
